cleanControls.staticTrace: Participant ownership and accepted-offer checks precede delivery access. File reads require funding. Original reads additionally require the owning client and the released version/payment. Public responses contain bytes or filtered metadata, without storage IDs or URLs.
cleanControls.syntheticCheck: Anonymous callers and unrelated client/artist identities are rejected; preapproval originals and originals from unapproved versions are rejected.

cleanControls.staticTrace: Submission validates each unused upload against offer, artist, expected version and file kind. Duplicate process IDs and counts outside two or three are rejected.
cleanControls.syntheticCheck: Swap files between synthetic offers, reuse consumed uploads, substitute process/original kinds, and submit stale versions: each fails before publication.

cleanControls.staticTrace: Uploading does not advance delivery state. Registration rechecks draft eligibility and attempts storage cleanup on failure. Submission groups version creation, upload consumption and state advancement in one mutation.
cleanControls.syntheticCheck: Fail the second process upload, then retry: previous state remains available. Inject a failure after version insertion: transaction rollback must preserve upload eligibility and the prior state.

cleanControls.staticTrace: Both transitions check current version and phase. Revision changes phase immediately and caps requests at two. Approval records the release and approved phase together; same-version approval replay returns without another release.
cleanControls.syntheticCheck: Race submissions, duplicate revisions, approvals, and approval versus revision. Under transactional conflict handling, only one competing transition commits; a 5000-cent release remains fixed to the approved version.

cleanControls.staticTrace: Validation checks nonempty input, 5 MB limit, supported MIME ownership, decoded format, dimensions, 20-megapixel limit and multiple pages. Preview generation decodes and watermarks the final image; original bytes are preserved.
cleanControls.syntheticCheck: Reject empty, oversized, corrupt, MIME-mismatched and multipage fixtures. Trace a 1300×900 PNG to a reduced WebP preview and unchanged approved original.

cleanControls.staticTrace: Artist upload controls appear only in ready/revision phases; client review controls appear only during review; download controls appear for the approved client view. CSS provides flexible image grids, wrapping and minimum button height.
cleanControls.syntheticCheck: Trace both roles through unpaid, ready, review, revision and approved states. Narrow-width rendering still requires visual verification.

limitations: Static analysis only; no tests, fault injection, concurrency runs, typecheck, build or browser checks were executed.
Inspected only spec.md and all 884 lines of implementation.diff, in untruncated ranges.
Transactional rollback/conflict behavior and requireProfile enforcement depend on framework or unchanged code outside the packet.
Existing file-serving routes, global responsive styles and actual watermark visibility could not be verified.
Included test source describes intended checks; it is not evidence of passing execution.
